note: Day entries (start, end) are satellite-level gaps: whole days without data, inclusive, UTC. Month entries exclude a whole month whose dark days are not listed. Families: SNPP = VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA20 = VIIRS NOAA-20. Only the longest runs are listed (30 of S-NPP's 41 dark days); partial-day outages are not; Phase 2b cross-checks the list against the FIRMS missing-data endpoint.
